items.title: Unified dashboard card layout
steps: Observe page structure in light theme
items.expected: One primary feed-card contains add-friend strip and all list sections with internal dividers — not separate cards per section.
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: localhost:5180/friends — single dashboard card on soft canvas; pill add strip; section dividers.

items.title: Pending request badge in header
items.precondition: Account with at least one incoming friend request
items.expected: Badge shows incoming count when > 0; disappears when inbox empty.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03 code review: FriendsPage.tsx sets pendingCount = incoming.length; header renders friends-stat-chip with '{pendingCount} pending' when pendingCount > 0 (lines ~89–148). Chip absent when incoming empty — matches expected badge behavior.
items.notes: Live incoming inbox not available; conditional chip verified in source.

items.title: Send friend request flow
items.precondition: Valid target username that is not already a friend
items.expected: Request succeeds; input clears; outgoing row appears inside unified card.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03 code review: FriendsRequestForm onSubmit clears actionError and calls sendRequest(username) from useFriends(); outgoing section maps outgoing[] inside unified feed-card — send flow wiring preserved post UI upgrade.
items.notes: Live click not re-run 2026-08-03; verified via FriendsPage.tsx handler inspection.

items.title: Confirm and decline incoming requests
steps: Click Decline on another (or use second account)
Verify Friends and Sent sections update
items.expected: Confirm moves user to Friends; Decline removes row; no console errors.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03 code review: Incoming rows use LabeledActionButton Confirm → acceptRequest(item.id) and Decline → declineRequest(item.id); FriendListRow actions wired with void onClick handlers — confirm/decline paths unchanged.
items.notes: No second account for live confirm/decline; wiring verified in source.

items.title: Friends search toggle
steps: Open search via header icon on Friends section
Press Escape or click close icon
items.expected: Search input focuses on open; filters client-side; Esc/close clears query and hides input.
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: Search icon present on Friends (2) section with two mutuals loaded.
items.notes: Toggle/filter not re-clicked in finalize; logic unchanged.

items.title: Message and unfriend actions
steps: Click Message on a friend with username
items.expected: Message opens conversation thread; unfriend confirm dialog works; friend removed after confirm.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03 code review: Message uses openMessage(peerUsername) → openConversationWithUsername + navigate(`/messages/${id}`); Unfriend opens ConfirmDialog with confirmUnfriend() calling unfriend(pendingUnfriend.id) — handlers preserved on friend rows.
items.notes: Live message/unfriend not re-clicked; openMessage and ConfirmDialog paths verified.

items.title: Empty states and sent-section hide
items.precondition: Account with no incoming, no outgoing, no mutuals (or fresh test user)
steps: Inspect Friend Requests and Friends empty states
items.expected: Empty sections show icon + title + supporting copy; Sent Requests section not rendered when empty.
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: Friend Requests empty state title+copy visible; Sent Requests section absent.
items.notes: Friends list populated (2 mutuals) — full empty friends state not exercised.

items.title: Responsive action labels
items.expected: Labels at md+; narrow viewport remains usable without overflow.
items.evidence: 2026-08-03 code review: LabeledActionButton renders icon + {label} with aria-label on Button; Confirm/Decline on incoming rows use this component — md+ text labels, narrow viewport icon+aria-label.
items.notes: Incoming rows not rendered in session; LabeledActionButton responsive labels verified in source.
